Schedulala 1.1.0

- Adds support for scheduling and publishing social posts to 12 platforms, including Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, and more.
- Introduces new features: auto-posting the first comment, analytics checks, engagement (replies/moderation), keyword monitoring, and YouTube video repurposing.
- Outlines credential setup—including API key, device flow, and permissions—for improved security and sandbox/test support.
- Details workflow for drafts, previews, validation, confirmation, and safe publishing with clear guidance for agent/client integration.
- Enhances OAuth and account connection flows, ensuring all authentication and payments happen securely via Schedulala.com.
